confidence_notes: June 2026 Numbeo averages inform meals, cappuccino and draft beer. A sparse current Expatistan entry informs the cocktail estimate; wine is inferred from its price relationship to beer because a robust glass-price average was not available. Accommodation is a holistic estimate, with hostel prices especially uncertain.
comparable_city_reasoning: For accommodation, Abu Dhabi is estimated above the supplied Amman, Dahab and Alanya examples and around or somewhat above Doha, reflecting its capital and business travel demand. Food and drink estimates use reported Abu Dhabi cost-of-living prices.
